name: Open-Face Veggie Ground & Mushroom Gravy Buns with Fresh Orange
instructions: Wash, dry, and thinly slice mushrooms.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom; add mushrooms, veggie ground, and spices. Cook, breaking the veggie ground apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, about 5 minutes.
Sprinkle flour into the skillet; continue to cook, stirring constantly, until lightly golden, about 1 minute.

Add milk and soy sauce to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to medium-low and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until gravy has thickened, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the oranges, then cut into wedges.
Divide buns between plates and top with gravy; serve with orange wedges on the side. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
